title: Occasional Pantry & International Shoppers
description: This segment infrequently purchases groceries, showing a higher proportion of spending on canned goods, dry pasta, and pantry staples. They explore new products more often but place fewer orders and purchase fewer unique items overall. Their affinity for international and meat/seafood is also notable, with a lower reorder rate.

title: Household & Personal Care Shoppers
description: This segment focuses heavily on household essentials and personal care items. They purchase significantly fewer items overall compared to the average customer. Their basket composition suggests a primary focus on non-food necessities, with minimal spending on fresh produce, deli, or meat.

title: Family Essentials & Broader Shoppers
description: This segment purchases a wider variety of products and departments, including a notable percentage in babies. They have larger basket sizes and higher reorder rates. Alcohol and household product purchases are lower than average.

title: Frequent, Diverse Shoppers
description: These customers order frequently and purchase a wide variety of unique products across many aisles. They demonstrate a strong tendency to reorder items, indicating loyalty and consistent needs. Their shopping habits suggest they are well-established users of the online grocery service.

title: Beverage & Snack Enthusiasts with Alcohol
description: This segment shows a strong preference for beverages and snacks, significantly exceeding the average. They also exhibit a notable interest in alcohol purchases. Conversely, they under-index in baby products, dry goods, canned goods, and meat/seafood. This suggests a focus on indulgent and convenient consumption.

title: Produce-Focused, Low Volume Shoppers
description: This segment heavily prioritizes produce purchases, spending over half their budget on fresh items. They exhibit a significantly lower overall purchase volume compared to the average customer.  They show minimal or no spending in categories like pets, alcohol, babies, and international foods. Their purchasing behavior suggests a targeted, potentially health-conscious shopper focused on a specific product category.

title: Frequent Breakfast & Frozen Food Buyers
description: This segment actively purchases breakfast items, frozen foods, and bakery goods. They tend to buy a smaller quantity of unique items compared to the average customer. Their purchasing behavior suggests a focus on convenient, ready-to-prepare meals and staples.
